messages.survival.explore: Walk with [←] [→] or click the papyrus. Click a glowing figure to look; the whole scroll is open to explore.
messages.survival.start: Walk left through the scroll of food, water and breath. Click a figure to look, or open the Journal to read what you have seen.
messages.survival.dwelling: Please claim your rightful seat so you may return to your dwelling.
messages.survival.died: His head has fallen. He begins again.
messages.survival.mummy: He comes out of the gate's dark as the man of spell 46. There is no way back.
messages.survival.upside: He goes headlong. Drag him up to stand upright.
messages.survival.filth: Headlong, he eats filth. A was-sceptre is lost.
messages.survival.water57: Water only dribbles from the goddess's vase. Click it to stand beneath it.
messages.survival.bend: Hold [space] to keep him up with his hands in the water; [esc] leaves.
